profile.reading: This record in this registry is named The Seattle Times, and it sits at coordinates matching 1000 Denny Way, Seattle, Washington 98109, the address the operator own facility page publishes for its Seattle data center, and coincidentally also the address Wikipedia gives for the Seattle Times newspaper own current headquarters building, occupied since 2011. Whether the data center and the newspaper headquarters share the same building or sit within the same address complex is not independently confirmed beyond this address match, so this record is treated as the site of the operator Seattle facility on that basis. The operator own facility page states 293,000 square feet, N+1 UPS power, 48 hour diesel runtime generator backup, and N+1 chillers, cooling towers, and CRAHs, with 40 plus on net carriers and Seattle Internet Exchange access. No MW capacity figure is published for this specific building.
